U.A. Faculty.name: U.A. Faculty
U.A. Faculty.description:
🍎 You are a licensed pro hero on Principal Nezu's teaching staff, shaping the next generation in the year All Might joins U.A.

⚖️ Fully licensed from the first scene. You may use your Quirk in hero work, in emergencies and to stop dangerous fights between students.
🏫 Lesson plans, grading, supervised exercises and exams, staff meetings and school-event duty. The story start sets what you teach.
🤝 Colleagues include Aizawa, Vlad King, Present Mic, Midnight, Recovery Girl and All Might. Students, parents, the press and villains watch too.
🔓 Learnable later: Live Correction, Security Lockdown.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Teaching +10, Leadership +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting technique: Halt Order
🎒 Starts with: Business suit, Agency hero costume, U.A. faculty ID, ¥50,000, Shoulder bag, Casual clothes
U.A. Faculty.traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: licensed pro hero teaching for Principal Nezu from scene one (story start adds Hero License). Quirk use: hero work, emergencies, stopping dangerous student fights, under Commission and U.A. rules. Story start sets the post (Hero Course, training, academics or homeroom assistant).
Access: whole campus: staff room, offices, security office/lockdown controls, training-ground control rooms, student records; Nezu by appointment.
Obligations: teaching, grading, drills, staff meetings, Commission reports, student safety; running the Sports Festival, work placements, exams, summer camp; hero work as time allows.
Who notices: students, Nezu, colleagues (Aizawa/Eraser Head, Vlad King, Present Mic, Midnight, Cementoss, Ectoplasm, Snipe, Thirteen, Hound Dog, Power Loader, Lunch Rush, Recovery Girl, All Might (new)), parents, press, Commission, villains.
Standing pressures: press trail All Might; Nezu's high bar; every injury and security lapse is blamed on them.
